newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR West rises on second day of trade.
newsitem.headline: JR West rises on second day of trade.

text.p: Shares in West Japan Railways rose on their second day of trade on Wednesday due to relief that Tuesday's listing went smoothly, brokers said.
As of 0035 GMT, the shares were 2,000 yen higher at 369,000 yen. Trade volume was 14,094.
Some brokers said that both institutional and private investors were showing interest in the shares.
They said the attention was due to the fact that JR West shares were cheaper than East Japan Railway Co shares and some investors were switching from East to West.
JR East shares were down 10,000 yen at 499,000 yen.
